borders.reason: Authored organic RGBA overlay fragments. Exact seamless adjacency, compass mask orientations, and renderer blending remain unverified. These are not a validated automatic bitmask set.
borders.renderGuidance: Use deterministic renderer-selected alpha-overlay placement over opaque underlying ground. Do not use the 16 overlays as automatic Wang or bitmask states. Full floor tile coverage and neighbor matching require renderer integration.

alpha.note: Genuine alpha retained through crop and resampling. Source hidden RGB can look like a backdrop in viewers ignoring alpha; compositing verifies transparency.

qa.cropCorrection: ANT-PROP-06 source cell bottom trimmed to remove one faint detached pixel belonging to the next row; anchor recalculated after crop.

wallNotes: Original WALL-01 and WALL-05 slope down-right. Reauthored WALL-02 and WALL-06 rise up-right, providing perpendicular straight facings. Only these two atlas components use the correction source; other six preserve original artwork.
